::: {#exm-transitive-or-not}
#### Transitive or not

- The relation $B$ of @exm-beats is not transitive (@def-transitive), as @sol-beats-transitive found.
- The relation $T$ of @exm-shares-letter is not transitive:
  $\text{cat} \mathrel{T} \text{cow}$ and $\text{cow} \mathrel{T} \text{dog}$,
  but $(\text{cat}, \text{dog}) \notin T$.
- The relation $P$ of @exm-parent is not transitive:
  Ada is a parent of Ben and Ben is a parent of Dev,
  but Ada is not a parent of Dev.
- For a set $U$, the relation $\subseteq$ on $\mathcal{P}(U)$ is transitive, by @thm-subset-transitive.

:::
